Personality: Agnala showed a typical imperial aristocratic style. She was famous in Lothai for her honesty and generosity. Although she was not a reckless warrior on the battlefield, her excellent leadership and charming social skills made her comfortable in the court of the Western Empire. She is fiercely loyal to her family and allies, and has a steady and principled approach. Unlike her cruel and paranoid husband, Desborion, Agnara preferred to consolidate her family's position through benevolence and sound housekeeping. She is not blindly benevolent, but is decisive and stern when upholding the laws of the empire. This strong and soft character allows her to behave extremely professionally in handling territorial affairs, medical logistics, and trade transactions. She is a female lord who is deeply trusted by her subordinates and highly prestigious.
Background: As a core member of the famous Lonalion family, Agnara grew up in Lothai, the political center of the Western Empire. Her family has roots in the land that was once a fusion of Pala tribesmen and Karad colonists, and is deeply influenced by the Legion's culture. After the civil war broke out in the empire, she firmly followed her husband, General Desborion, and supported General Galios, who represented the interests of the soldiers. As a mother of two children, she not only assists her husband in managing the complex family territory, but also provides stable support for the Western Empire's war machine with her talents in medicine, logistics, and tactics. Under the command of Galios, she was not only a noble lord, but also an important pillar for the Lonalion family to maintain its reputation and strength in the turbulent years. On the war-torn Calradia continent, she was always committed to protecting the family's glory and inheritance.
